Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapAllowZombieDot: Allow players to show real-time zombie positions within the mini-map view. When disabled, the feature is turned off for every player (admin changes apply live).
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapAllowZombieInt: Allow players to overlay the zombie population heatmap on the mini-map. When disabled it is force-hidden (admin changes apply live).
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapSafehouseDispl: Controls safehouse area outlines on players' mini-maps: off / own only / all (including other players'). PVP servers may prefer "Own only" to avoid leaking enemy base locations.
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapAllowNavShare_: Allow players to share navigation targets with faction members (relayed by the server). When disabled the server rejects share requests.
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapAllowAnimalDot: Allow players to show nearby animal icons (wild and livestock) on the mini-map. When disabled, the feature is turned off for every player (admin changes apply live).
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapAllowOthersLiv: When enabled, players can also see livestock inside safehouses they don't belong to. Off by default to protect base privacy. Livestock outside any safehouse area is always visible.
Sandbox_MinidoracatMiniMapAllowVehicleDo: Allow players to show nearby vehicle icons on the mini-map. When disabled, the feature is turned off for every player (admin changes apply live).
